name: German European School Singapore
summary: German and European / IB pathways for German-speaking and international families — Dairy Farm / west-central gravity.
body: GESS serves German-curriculum and European/IB tracks, making it a default shortlist for German and Swiss-German households — and others seeking European schooling. Confirm language of instruction by section when you apply; German-section demand tracks corporate relocation cycles. Campus geography sits in the west-central / Dairy Farm belt — pair housing decisions with school-bus catchments rather than CBD prestige postcodes. Verify current campus map, section availability, and fee stack on gess.sg.
waitlistNotes: German-section demand tracks corporate relocation cycles — ask for dated section openings.
